title: Booking a visit
purpose: How a booking is entered so the day works; step 6 is the read-back that the declined team note repeated (S4).
facts: Eight steps: find by phone; which shop; car and complaint in the customer's words; job from the catalogue; slot rules; read-back; source; shuttle and fleet details.

Slots: drop-offs 7:30, 8:00, 8:30; waiters 9:00-14:00 for jobs of an hour or less; diagnostics in slot 10's or slot 18's column; nothing over three hours after 13:00; Monday before 9:30 at east is A2's.

Step 6, the read-back (day, time, shop, work), is the point of slot 6's team note "Read the booking back before hanging up", proposed on the Monday of week T-3 and declined by slot 4: "the page 'Booking a visit' already says this; propose the wording there" (stories/S04, ledger s4.notes).
Source of the booking is recorded (ERP appointment: phone, web chat, messenger, walk-in).
The assistant cannot book; it raises a hand-over card and an advisor books (design 7.2 S7).

list_items.item: Find the customer by phone number. Do not make a new one if the phone is already there: Customer records.
Which shop. Say it out loud. People book East Main and drive to Bonny Oaks.
The car and the complaint, in their words. "Grinding from the front when braking, started Tuesday." Not "brakes".
Pick the job from the catalogue so the booking has hours on it. A noise or a light is an inspection or a diagnosis, not a repair.
Drop-off appointments at 7:30, 8:00 and 8:30. Waiters between 9:00 and 2:00, for jobs of an hour or less.
Check-engine and electrical work goes in the diagnostic column (Kevin at East Main, Andre at Bonny Oaks). When the column is full, offer the next day.
Do not book a job longer than three hours after 1:00.
Mondays at Bonny Oaks before 9:30 belong to Millsaps.
Read it back: day, time, which shop, what we are doing. Every booking, every time, even to a regular. "So that is Friday at eight, East Main Street, for a brake inspection."
Where it came from: phone, web chat, messenger or walk-in. Fill it in. It is how we know what the chat is worth.
Shuttle needed? Say the times. Company vehicle? Unit number, and for Nickajack the purchase-order number.

new_facts: Slot rules: drop-offs at 7:30, 8:00, 8:30; waiters 9:00-14:00; nothing over three hours after 13:00. ERP appointment times should follow them.
